title: Hoodi validator lifecycle with auditable UC-1 through UC-5
expected_outcome: A release-contained, fail-closed Hoodi validator lifecycle is implemented: an operator can create a fresh key outside the repository, prepare a verifiable deposit package, deploy a hardened remote signer and Prysm validator client, and collect non-secret evidence for deposit observation, activation, duties, fencing, and recovery.
constraints: Never reuse the earlier test-only validator key or test-only signer database for a deposit or validator duty.
Never put a mnemonic, wallet private key, recovery key, Vault token, keystore password, or encrypted keystore in Git, CI output, Kubernetes manifests, task evidence, or command arguments.
The human alone signs the exact 32 HoodiETH deposit transaction after independently verifying the deposit data.
No validator client may start signing until execution and consensus sync, signer authentication, persistent slashing protection, and the intended deposit public key are verified.
All persistent operational logs are non-secret and redact bearer credentials and key material.

external_actions: read-only private EKS and Vault health inspection
deployment only after preflight gates and explicit user confirmation of the public validator key and withdrawal address

primary_owner.responsibility: validator security architecture, UC integration, activation gate
